name: labs/yuanxun-yx__syrpp
title: New Era SyringeONE NE-1000 syringe pump (syrpp.SyrPump)
intro: New Era SyringeONE NE-1000 syringe pump (syrpp.SyrPump), adapted from yuanxun-yx/syrpp. It reads `status`, `firmware_version`, `volume` and `volume_dispensed`; sets `diameter`, `phase`, `phase_function`, `pumping_rate` and 5 more; runs `start_program` and `stop_program`. `start_program`: start the configured pumping program (RUN) and report the pump prompt afterwards. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/yuanxun-yx__syrpp --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/yuanxun-yx__syrpp --backend fake --mcp
